args.text: [lane-heron] Three risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers for too long: (1) Stale answers: users are sent to old addresses after a server moves, causing outages or failed connections. (2) Slow recovery: fixes or failovers to new addresses take longer to reach users. (3) Prolonged poisoning: a forged or wrong answer stays in the cache longer, so more users are misdirected for longer.

[lane-heron] Idempotent retries matter because networks fail in ways that leave you unsure whether a request worked, so retrying is often the only safe choice. If the request is idempotent (repeating it gives the same result as doing it once), a retry cannot cause double charges, duplicate orders or other repeated side effects.
